note: R3.0C C5_DELTA_METRICS state. Nine authorized renderer/js production paths: C1 adapter + three C2 services + C3 normalize-distance + three C4 services + the C5 delta-metrics service. delta_metrics_present is the new C5 capability, unlocked at C5_DELTA_METRICS per schema.json. The C5 service computes six allowlisted delta metrics (lap_time, delta_cumulative, sector_delta, entry_delta, mid_delta, exit_delta) using the SINGLE pinned sign convention delta = comparison - reference. Any caller request that names a metric outside the allowlist is UNSUPPORTED_METRIC; any attempt to switch sign or supply policy.deltaSign !== 'comparison_minus_reference' is DELTA_METRIC_SIGN_FORBIDDEN. Corner-scope metrics fail-closed with DELTA_METRIC_CORNER_PAIR_REQUIRED when no pair is supplied; per-pair NaN / Infinity / missing zone times block ONLY that pair (partial-result model) — unrelated metrics still compute. uiAllowed / featureRegistryActivationAllowed remain false: UI lives at C7_UI, activation at C8_ACTIVATION. Comparison export remains locked behind C6. The three R3.0C feature IDs (case_comparison, reference_lap, corner_delta) remain availability='deferred' in renderer/js/feature-registry.js with NO rendererAdapter until C8 authorizes activation.
